messages:
maria: seeing p95 spikes in east-west during 11:30-12:15 batching window. noticed two racks affected.
aj: saw that too. p95 jumped from 6ms -> 80-120ms for grpc calls to gnode replicas.
sandeep: any packet loss? counters?
maria: small packetloss on rx_err on rnic0 on nodes in rack-12b. logs attached below.
aj: can you paste ethtool?
maria: ```
# ethtool -S rnic0 | egrep "rx_err|tx_err|rx_packets"
rx_packets: 12345678
rx_err: 42
tx_err: 0
```
kai: also ran ibv_rc_pingpong between two GPUs, latency jumped during spike
kai: ```
# ibv_rc_pingpong -d mlx5_0 10.0.12.34: 2ms -> 120ms tail
```
infra-bot: deploy event: kube-daemonset/net-tuning v2 deployed 3532107000
sandeep: wait, we rolled net-tuning v2 to ~rack-12b earlier today. could be mtu changes.
maria: confirmed: /etc/cluster/mtu.conf shows 9000 on most nodes, but new ds set some nodes to 1500
aj: mtu mismatch -> offload fallback + fragmentation -> RDMA fallback causing handshake delays :thinking_face:
kai: grep in kube daemonset: `mtu: "1500"` on 2 pods
maria: temporary mitigation: force set MTU 9000 on affected interfaces, rebooted one node -> p95 back to 8ms
aj: recommend rollback net-tuning v2 to canary state, and run cluster-wide mtud test script
sandeep: adding traffic-shaper rule to limit burst to avoid microbursts at ToR
maria: operational checklist I've been doing:
- collect ethtool counters
- ibv_rc_pingpong before/after
- tcpdump fragment prints `ip[6:2]` > 1500
- check kube ds revision
kai: can we add an alert when MTU heterogeneity detected? openshift/k8s node labels mismatches
aj: yes, create a prometheus rule on `node_network_mtu` variance
infra-bot: incident created: INC-9872
sandeep: I'll roll back net-tuning v2 in rack-12b now, ETA 8m
maria: thanks — will monitor KV cache warmups too, earlier spikes coincided with cold KV cache which amplifies p95
aj: postmortem candidate if rollout caused this. assign to rollout-owner and infra oncall
maria: noted. thanks team :thumbsup:
